name: vertex-flow-obsidian
description: A keyboard-first task manager stored entirely as Markdown: projects, tasks, boards, calendars, timelines, chart dashboards, saved views, and an offline help system.

scripts.build: node scripts/build-help.mjs && node scripts/build-templates.mjs && tsc --noEmit && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.release:preflight: pnpm test && pnpm build && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const manifest=require('./manifest.json'); const cl=fs.readFileSync('CHANGELOG.md','utf8'); if (!/^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/.test(manifest.version)) throw new Error('manifest.json version must be x.y.z'); if (!cl.includes('## ' + manifest.version)) throw new Error('CHANGELOG.md has no heading for v' + manifest.version); for (const file of ['main.js','manifest.json','styles.css']) { if (!fs.existsSync(file) || fs.statSync(file).size === 0) throw new Error(file + ' is missing or empty'); } console.log('Release preflight passed for ' + manifest.version);"

author: JR Leonard
